title: NFT: Bridging Supervised Learning and Reinforcement Learning in Math Reasoning
authors_zh: Huayu Chen；Kaiwen Zheng；Qinsheng Zhang；Ganqu Cui；Lifan Yuan；Yin Cui；Haotian Ye；Tsung-Yi Lin；Ming-Yu Liu；Jun Zhu；Haoxiang Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: NFT trains math reasoning from verifier-separated positive and negative rollouts instead of treating rejected answers as disposable.
NFT 在 DAPO-Math-17k 上进行在线训练：每个 rollout step 抽取 512 个问题、每题生成 16 个答案，并用二元正确性信号同时利用正例和负例。
why: It is a concrete accepted/rejected rollout recipe, but its reuse is limited by missing verifier, rollout, and release-provenance details.
inclusion_reason: It is a concrete accepted/rejected rollout recipe, but its reuse is limited by missing verifier, rollout, and release-provenance details.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Online math post-training can generate answers from the current policy and label them with a binary correctness verifier. Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) keeps only correct answers for supervised learning, so expensive incorrect rollouts are discarded; policy-gradient methods such as GRPO use both reward signs but require an RL optimization formulation. NFT asks whether supervised maximum-likelihood training can also learn directly from the model's own failures.

The ICLR 2026 work uses DAPO-Math-17k questions and, at each rollout step, samples 512 prompts with 16 answers each. The data object is an online prompt group containing every answer trajectory, binary correctness, per-question success rate, and old-policy token likelihoods. This supports positive and implicit-negative likelihood terms rather than a static paired preference dataset. The official paper, NVIDIA project page, NVlabs/NFT Apache-2.0 code repository, DAPO-Math-17k dataset, and NFT-7B/NFT-32B weights are confirmed. The repository improves reproducibility, but it does not establish a complete release of all 320 rollout steps, rejected traces, verifier decisions, and optimizer lineage.

在线数学后训练可以由当前 policy 生成答案，再用二元正确性 verifier 打标签。Rejection Fine-Tuning（RFT）只保留正确答案做 supervised learning，因此成本高昂的错误 rollout 被丢弃；GRPO 等 policy-gradient 方法会利用正负 reward，但需要 RL 优化形式。NFT 研究的问题是：supervised maximum-likelihood training 能否也直接从模型自身失败中学习。

这项 ICLR 2026 工作使用 DAPO-Math-17k 问题，每个 rollout step 抽取 512 个 prompt，并为每题生成 16 条答案。数据对象是在线 prompt group，其中包含每条答案轨迹、二元正确性、逐题成功率和 old-policy token likelihood；它用于正向与 implicit-negative likelihood term，而不是静态成对偏好数据。已确认官方论文、NVIDIA 项目页、Apache-2.0 的 NVlabs/NFT 代码仓库、DAPO-Math-17k 数据集以及 NFT-7B/NFT-32B 权重。仓库提高了复现性，但没有证明 320 个 rollout step 的全部被拒轨迹、verifier 决策和 optimizer lineage 已完整发布。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
For a question q, the current generation policy is split conceptually into a positive policy conditioned on reward 1 and a negative policy conditioned on reward 0. Their mixture, weighted by the question's empirical success rate, reconstructs the old policy. NFT parameterizes an implicit negative policy using the same trainable positive model and the frozen old-policy likelihood, so maximum-likelihood training on a negative answer changes the positive model without storing a second network. Positive answers use the usual likelihood-ratio term; negative answers use the implied negative likelihood ratio.

The practical token-level objective stores the old token probabilities, estimates success rate from 16 binary labels, filters groups without both reward outcomes, clips the negative likelihood ratio with a straight-through maximum to avoid invalid logarithms, and weights harder prompts more strongly. The default negative clip is 1.0. In strict on-policy conditions and with the specified prompt weighting, the paper proves the NFT and GRPO gradients coincide; off policy, their clipping behavior differs. Compared with RFT, the contribution is retaining incorrect generations as supervised optimization signals; compared with GRPO/DAPO, it provides a maximum-likelihood interpretation rather than a new verifier.

对问题 q，当前 generation policy 在概念上被拆成以 reward 1 为条件的 positive policy 和以 reward 0 为条件的 negative policy；二者按该题经验成功率加权后重构 old policy。NFT 用同一个可训练 positive model 和冻结的 old-policy likelihood 参数化 implicit negative policy，因此在负答案上做 maximum-likelihood training 就能更新 positive model，无需保存第二个网络。正答案使用常规 likelihood-ratio term，负答案使用由混合关系推导的 negative likelihood ratio。

实际 token-level objective 保存旧 token 概率，从 16 个二元标签估计成功率，过滤没有同时出现正负 reward 的 group，用 straight-through maximum 截断 negative likelihood ratio 以避免无效对数，并提高困难 prompt 权重。默认 negative clip 为 1.0。在严格 on-policy 条件和指定 prompt weighting 下，论文证明 NFT 与 GRPO 梯度相同；进入 off-policy 后，两者 clipping 行为不同。相较 RFT，贡献是把错误生成保留为监督优化信号；相较 GRPO/DAPO，它提供 maximum-likelihood 解释，而不是新的 verifier。

title: Method
方法
html:
Experiments start from Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen2.5-32B and use DAPO-Math-17k, whose prompts carry integer ground-truth answers and an Apache-2.0 dataset license. Each rollout step samples 512 questions and generates 16 answers per question at temperature 1.0. A programmatic answer verifier assigns r in {0,1}; the implementation stores token-level old-policy likelihoods and the group success rate. Only groups with both positive and negative answers enter the NFT update. Data is divided into 16 mini-batches for 16 gradient steps; 320 rollout steps yield slightly over 5,000 gradient steps.

The shared learning rate is 1e-6 with linear warm-up. NFT inherits VeRL/DAPO dynamic sampling, token-level loss normalization, and no KL regularization. Seven-billion-parameter training uses a 4K context on 64 H100 GPUs; NFT-32B uses a 16K context and 128-256 H100 GPUs. Truncated answers are labeled negative, the negative-ratio clip is 1.0, and harder-question weighting follows the paper's GRPO-aligned option. Evaluation covers AIME24, AIME25, AMC23, MATH500, OlympiadBench, and Minerva Math, using math-verify for training validation and simpleRL for final evaluation.

The official repository supplies training scripts, verifier code, evaluation tooling, and download scripts; NVIDIA publishes NFT-7B and NFT-32B weights under a non-commercial model license. A reusable trace release would additionally need exact dataset/model commits, all generated answers, extracted answers, verifier outcomes, truncation flags, likelihood arrays, dynamic-resampling history, and seeds. Those run-level artifacts were not confirmed as complete.

实验从 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Qwen2.5-32B 开始，使用 DAPO-Math-17k；该数据集的 prompt 带整数 ground-truth answer，许可证为 Apache-2.0。每个 rollout step 抽取 512 道题，以 temperature 1.0 为每题生成 16 条答案。程序化 answer verifier 给出 r∈{0,1}；实现保存 token-level old-policy likelihood 与组内成功率。只有同时包含正负答案的 group 才进入 NFT update。数据分成 16 个 mini-batch，执行 16 个 gradient step；320 个 rollout step 合计略多于 5,000 个 gradient step。

共同 learning rate 为 1e-6，并使用 linear warm-up。NFT 继承 VeRL/DAPO 的 dynamic sampling、token-level loss normalization 和无 KL regularization 设置。7B 训练在 64 张 H100 上使用 4K context；NFT-32B 使用 16K context 和 128–256 张 H100。被截断答案标为负例，negative-ratio clip 为 1.0，困难题加权采用论文中与 GRPO 对齐的选项。评测覆盖 AIME24、AIME25、AMC23、MATH500、OlympiadBench 和 Minerva Math；训练验证使用 math-verify，最终评测使用 simpleRL。

官方仓库提供训练脚本、verifier code、评测工具和下载脚本；NVIDIA 以非商业模型许可证发布 NFT-7B 与 NFT-32B 权重。可复用轨迹发布还应包含精确数据/模型 commit、全部生成答案、抽取答案、verifier 结果、截断标记、likelihood array、dynamic-resampling 历史和随机种子；目前未确认这些 run-level artifact 完整发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Using identical data, infrastructure, and broad hyperparameters, Table 1 reports an average of 51.7 for NFT versus 48.3 for RFT and 51.2 for DAPO on the 7B model across six math benchmarks. On the 32B model, NFT averages 59.2, RFT 52.8, and DAPO 59.9. The paper reports three to four independent 7B runs for training curves and shows that removing negative-data learning reduces validation performance. Ablations favor harder-question weighting and find that overly aggressive negative penalties hurt performance; the default clip is 1.0.

The paper's theoretical result establishes gradient equivalence with GRPO only in the strict on-policy case under its stated weighting and binary-reward assumptions. Empirical parity outside that boundary is experimental, not a general equivalence theorem. Benchmark results support the optimizer recipe, but do not show that every negative trace is informative or correctly labeled. The official weights and code improve reproducibility, yet raw online trace and verifier provenance remain incomplete.

在相同数据、基础设施和主要超参数下，表 1 报告 7B 模型在六个数学 benchmark 上 NFT 平均 51.7，RFT 为 48.3，DAPO 为 51.2。32B 模型中 NFT 为 59.2，RFT 为 52.8，DAPO 为 59.9。论文对 7B 训练曲线报告 3–4 次独立实验，并显示去掉负数据学习会降低验证表现。ablation 支持提高困难题权重，也显示过强负例惩罚会损害性能；默认 clip 为 1.0。

论文的理论结果只在严格 on-policy、指定权重和二元 reward 假设下证明与 GRPO 梯度等价；超出该边界的经验接近是实验结果，而非一般等价定理。benchmark 结果支持 optimizer recipe，但不能证明每条 negative trace 都有信息或标签正确。官方权重与代码提高了可复现性，但原始在线轨迹与 verifier provenance 仍不完整。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
RFT performs supervised maximum likelihood only on verifier-accepted answers; GRPO and DAPO assign group-relative advantages to both outcomes through policy-gradient objectives; preference methods require paired or ranked responses. NFT derives a negative conditional policy from the old policy, success rate, and trainable positive policy, then optimizes both accepted and rejected generations with a token-level supervised objective. It needs one trainable model because old-policy probabilities are cached.

The theoretical connection to GRPO clarifies that the supervised/RL distinction is partly an objective parameterization choice under binary on-policy data. The track-level direction signal is the explicit preservation of rejected trajectories, per-question reward mixtures, and old-policy likelihoods as valuable construction records. NFT does not introduce DAPO-Math-17k, VeRL, binary answer verification, dynamic sampling, or the Qwen models; its novelty is the implicit-negative likelihood and associated practical clipping/weighting. Benchmark gains are optimizer evidence, not proof that negatives are semantically valid, diverse, uncontaminated, or safe to reuse.

RFT 只在 verifier 接受的答案上执行 supervised maximum likelihood；GRPO 与 DAPO 通过 policy-gradient objective 为两种结果赋予 group-relative advantage；preference 方法则需要成对或排序响应。NFT 从 old policy、成功率和可训练 positive policy 推导 negative conditional policy，再用 token-level supervised objective 同时优化被接受与被拒生成。由于缓存 old-policy probability，它只需一个可训练模型。

与 GRPO 的理论联系说明：在二元 on-policy 数据条件下，supervised/RL 的差别部分来自 objective parameterization。对本 Track 的方向信号是明确保留被拒轨迹、逐题 reward mixture 与 old-policy likelihood，并把它们视为有价值的构造记录。NFT 并未提出 DAPO-Math-17k、VeRL、二元答案验证、dynamic sampling 或 Qwen 模型；新意是 implicit-negative likelihood 及相应 clipping/weighting。benchmark 提升是 optimizer 证据，不证明负例在语义上有效、多样、无污染或可安全复用。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
NFT assumes a reliable answer-level reward and estimates a question's success rate from only 16 samples. A false negative can directly suppress a correct trajectory, while a false positive enters the positive likelihood term. Treating every truncated answer as negative conflates correctness with length. Groups that are all correct or all incorrect are filtered from the update, so the training distribution is shaped by current-policy difficulty and verifier behavior. The strict on-policy equivalence result does not cover long off-policy reuse, non-binary rewards without additional assumptions, or other clipping choices.

Experiments are limited to Qwen math models and DAPO-Math-17k; transfer to code, open-ended judging, or noisy reward models is unknown. The 7B and 32B conditions use different context and compute scales. Official code is available, but the repository page shows a small commit history and should be pinned. Code/data use Apache-2.0 while NVIDIA model weights use a non-commercial license. Full online rollout logs, verifier decisions, dataset revisions, decontamination analysis, and per-run seeds are not established as released. The current arXiv v3 author list and older project BibTeX also differ, so citation metadata needs manual reconciliation.

NFT 假设答案级 reward 可靠，并仅用 16 个样本估计逐题成功率。false negative 会直接压低正确轨迹，false positive 则进入 positive likelihood term。把所有截断答案视为负例还混淆了正确性与长度。全对或全错的 group 会被过滤，因此训练分布受到当前 policy 难度与 verifier 行为共同塑造。严格 on-policy 等价结果不覆盖长期 off-policy 复用，也不在无额外假设时覆盖非二元 reward 或其他 clipping 选择。

实验仅限 Qwen 数学模型和 DAPO-Math-17k；对代码、开放式 judging 或 noisy reward model 的迁移未知。7B 与 32B 条件使用不同 context 与算力规模。虽然官方代码已发布，但仓库页面 commit history 较短，复现应固定版本。代码/数据使用 Apache-2.0，而 NVIDIA 模型权重使用非商业许可证。完整在线 rollout log、verifier 决策、数据 revision、去污染分析和逐 run 随机种子均未证实发布。当前 arXiv v3 作者列表与较旧 project BibTeX 也有差异，引用元数据需人工协调。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, NFT provides a concrete schema for accepted/rejected online groups: dataset item and revision; rendered prompt; old and updated checkpoint; 16 candidate traces; extracted final answers; binary verifier result and verifier version; per-question success rate; positive/negative partition; truncation; token-level old-policy likelihood; implicit-negative ratio; clip event; prompt weight; mini-batch and rollout step; and subsequent evaluation. All-positive/all-negative filtering should be recorded rather than silently dropping those groups.

These records can support research on learning from failures, verifier-error sensitivity, SFT/RL objective equivalence, and hard-prompt curricula. They also enable auditing whether a negative signal reflects a mathematical error, formatting failure, truncation, or verifier bug. Official code and weights make implementation studies possible, but absent raw trace logs mean the paper's original online dataset cannot be reconstructed exactly. Negative answers should not be published as generic bad demonstrations without their prompt, verifier, old policy, and sampling context.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace Track，NFT 给出了 accepted/rejected 在线 group 的具体 schema：数据 item 与 revision、渲染后 prompt、old/updated checkpoint、16 条候选轨迹、抽取最终答案、二元 verifier 结果与版本、逐题成功率、正负划分、截断状态、token-level old-policy likelihood、implicit-negative ratio、clip event、prompt weight、mini-batch 与 rollout step，以及后续评测。全对/全错 group 的过滤也应记录，不能静默丢弃。

这些记录可支持从失败学习、verifier-error 敏感性、SFT/RL objective 等价和困难 prompt curriculum 研究，也能审计一个负信号究竟来自数学错误、格式错误、截断还是 verifier bug。官方代码与权重支持实现研究，但缺少原始 trace log 意味着无法精确重建论文中的在线数据集。脱离 prompt、verifier、old policy 和采样上下文，不应把负答案作为通用“坏示范”发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Each rollout step samples 512 DAPO-Math-17k prompts and 16 answers per prompt.
  • NFT trains on both verifier-positive and verifier-negative answers through one parameterized positive model.
  • Strict on-policy NFT/GRPO gradient equivalence depends on binary rewards and the stated prompt weighting.
  • Official code, DAPO-Math-17k, and NFT-7B/NFT-32B weights are available under different licenses.
  • Complete rollout, verifier, and optimizer logs are not established as released.

• 每个 rollout step 从 DAPO-Math-17k 抽 512 个 prompt，每题生成 16 条答案。
  • NFT 通过同一个参数化 positive model 同时学习 verifier-positive 与 verifier-negative 答案。
  • 严格 on-policy 的 NFT/GRPO 梯度等价依赖二元 reward 与指定 prompt weighting。
  • 官方代码、DAPO-Math-17k 和 NFT-7B/NFT-32B 权重已发布，但许可证不同。
  • 完整 rollout、verifier 与 optimizer log 未证实发布。
